regions: p-Si from 0 to 1 um, n-Si from 1 to 2 um.
device_dimensions: 1 um of p-Si followed by 1 um of n-Si.
contacts: Use ideal ohmic ends with Fermi statistics for this reference. Explicitly record that the Al 4.10 eV value is descriptive only and Schottky barriers are not simulated.
physics: 300 K; Fermi statistics, SRH lifetimes 1 us each, Auger and Slotboom BGN. Retain requested mobility outputs. No avalanche, heating or tunnelling.
study: Drive the left p-side contact at exactly 0, +2 and -2 V. Ground the right contact. Adaptive intermediate convergence steps are allowed, not a dense requested sweep.
driven_contact: Left p-side driven, right n-side grounded.
profile_sampling: Full spatial profiles at 0, +2 and -2 V.
outputs: All original spatial outputs, both quasi-Fermi levels under bias and current densities per unit area, not absolute amperes.
prior_parameters: Read RESEARCH_CONTEXT.md for the original parameters. Use 1 um per silicon region and an explicitly authorized ideal ohmic reference with Fermi statistics.
